overallSummary: 本期无多人共识股。新开仓与加仓信号集中，其中 CoStar 集团、阿尔伯特森斯及 NRG 能源获高仓位投资者主动加仓，特斯拉亦获段永平新开仓，显示较强信心。自由资本等机构亦布局多只个股。若此前有股票跌出候选清单，通常因安全边际不再达标所致。整体来看，高仓位主动加仓是本期最显著信号。

stockNotes.name: 卡夫亨氏
stockNotes.holderText: 巴菲特（2.8%仓位，持有40季/10.0年，仓位未变）

stockNotes.verdictEn: Deep discount with a long-held, unchanged position, though the position size is not large, looks more like a low-cost core holding than a fresh buy signal.

Li Lu (2.1%)、Duan (7.9%) also hold this stock, but the margin of safety hasn't reached the 10% threshold yet, so they are not counted among the consensus holders.
